# Wrap up

Use only the private workspace. Read its `AGENTS.md`, conventions and local
system date. Ask for its location if invoked in the shared source repo.

1. Inspect today's existing log, the daily template, relevant task files and
   available evidence from the current work. Do not invent prior activity.
2. Summarize meaningful confirmed activity and discoveries. Keep completed,
   attempted, blocked and planned work separate; unfinished acceptance criteria
   cannot become completed work.
3. Create a missing log from the template or merge into the existing sections.
   Preserve human text and avoid repeated entries.
4. Add real task/note links, outstanding blockers and a clearly proposed next
   step. Do not create unrelated wiki notes or change task status.
5. Verify the local date and resulting log, report missing evidence, and do
   not auto-commit or publish.
